discussion_comments.comment_body: This only strips quoted event values. `` survives, is rendered in the local report, and can reach `articleUpdate`. Use an allowlist HTML sanitizer (or reject both quoted and unquoted handlers) and add a regression test.

The initial URL is allow-listed, but `redirect: "follow"` lets a response redirect to an unvalidated destination. Handle redirects manually and validate every hop before requesting it; apply the same policy to image downloads.
This fetch follows redirects after only checking the initial URL. Validate redirect destinations as well, including loopback/private IPv4 and IPv6 forms, before fetching the store homepage.

Blocking: this follows redirects after validating only the original URL. A public URL can redirect to an internal endpoint, bypassing `validateSafeUrl`; handle redirects manually and validate every target before requesting it.

This fetch runs for every configured custom domain before any URL safety check. A value such as `127.0.0.1` or a private DNS name therefore reaches the agent host; validate resolved destinations (including IPv6/link-local ranges) before requesting each candidate.

`redirect: 'follow'` bypasses the initial URL validation: a public URL can redirect to a loopback, link-local, or private address and the redirected target is never checked. Handle redirects manually and validate each hop (including resolved IPv4/IPv6 addresses) before requesting it.

This fetch probes an arbitrary user-supplied custom domain and follows redirects before validating it as Shopify. Do not automatically fetch arbitrary hosts here; require a validated Shopify admin/permanent domain or apply an SSRF-safe destination policy to every hop.

Validating only the original URL hostname is insufficient because fetch follows redirects by default. Reject redirects or revalidate each redirect target so an allowed Shopify CDN URL cannot redirect the process to an unapproved destination.

discussion_comments.comment_body: This hostname-text filter is not sufficient for an untrusted `--store` URL: IPv6 loopback/link-local forms and hostnames resolving to private addresses pass it, then `fetchText()` sends them through `http`/`https.get` at line 328. Resolve the host and reject private, loopback, link-local, and reserved IPv4/IPv6 addresses before every initial and redirected request.
